_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — obviously-fake values throughout. The real source-table-roster.json carries private estate data (real source DB names, real filesystem paths) and is gitignored, never committed. This file documents the required SHAPE every entry must carry; scripts/migrations/lib/verify15-shared.js's loadRoster() enforces the required-field list at runtime.

§6.1(h)/H-2 (memory-manager#11(h)): migrate-08-handoff-markdown.js's ACTIVE-file (HANDOFF.md) NEXT SESSION slice. source_table is the fixed logical slice name migrate-08-handoff-markdown.js's SLICE_NAMES.ACTIVE_NEXT_SESSION_ITEMS constant uses; targetTable is the real physical table (predicate='next_step' rows). source_db is H-14-normalized (forward slashes, uppercase drive letter) via scripts/lib/fs-path-normalize.js — SYNTHETIC path shown here.

§6.1(h)/H-2 (memory-manager#11(h)): migrate-08-handoff-markdown.js's ACTIVE-file (HANDOFF.md) latest-session-summary slice (predicate='session_tldr_archived' rows — H-1: never the live 1:1 session_tldr predicate).

SOURCELESS example — source_db uses the 'net-new:<store>' convention (see scripts/migrations/lib/verify15-shared.js classifyRosterSourceDb). This entry maps a §17/§18-shaped table (routing_profiles) that has NO migration source at all: nothing is ever migrated INTO it from an old store, so T1 never snapshots it and it never gets a migration_manifest row — by classification, not by omission. T0 (verify-15-t0-roster.js) exempts sourceless entries from the manifest-row requirement explicitly (prints them, never silently skips them); T3/T3b exclude them from source-hash comparisons and the total-rowcount anti-join for the identical reason. T5/T6 still enumerate this entry normally via their target-side (roster-driven) checks — sourceless does not mean untested, only 'no migration to reconcile.' source_table mirrors targetTable here since there is no real source-side table name to record.
